title: Overview
content_data:
TikTok Store is an entity or object that allows a merchant to manage and sell products on TikTok. TikTok creators can bind their TikTok account to the store to start selling products using their TikTok account.

Below are some roles and concepts for TikTok Store. - Merchant: A person or company that wants to sell products on TikTok. - Developer: A person or technical partner that is responsible for integrating or using TikTok Marketing API. - TikTok business account: A TikTok account type that provides capabilities for businesses to directly promote their products via their own account and get insights into audiences. - TikTok For Business account: An account that is intended to be used by advertisers or agencies to manage ad campaigns and measure ad performances. - TikTok API for Business developer application: This is an entity that carries the permissions that a merchant or advertiser grants to a developer, so that the developer can manage their TikTok For Business account on their behalf.
